verdict.rationale: Langfuse explicitly supports building 'a reusable set of test cases' via Datasets, running Experiments against datasets to test prompt/model/code changes, comparing outputs side-by-side, and blocking deploys on regressions via CI/CD experiments — directly matching curation-from-traces plus offline evaluation. Additional docs cover wrapping app functions in experiment tasks run on fixed datasets and reviewing failures, and traces feed directly into these workflows. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating the dataset-curation-from-production-traces workflow beyond vendor docs.
